verdict.rationale: A product-management platform could plausibly offer a rich text editor for changelog and help content, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never describes rich text formatting, custom components, or changelog/help authoring. The only related item is an API for managing 'editor documents' with templates and comments, which is an adjacent document-management capability, not the editor described in the story.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can use a rich text editor with custom components to format changelog and help content
